payload.core_mechanism_summary: Computes sum of max prefix sums using combinatorial formula: calc(i) = C(N+M,M) if N-M>i else C(N+M,M+i); answer = sum i*(calc(i)-calc(i+1)). Factorial precomputation for binomial coefficients modulo P.
payload.rationale: Solution uses closed-form combinatorial expressions with binomial coefficients rather than DP recurrence. No DP state table or memoization is used; family mismatch expected.
